selection_uses: calendar identity and circuit characteristics, not acquired results or observed model errors
unlock_gate: Freeze candidate code commit, policy, feature contract and scoring manifest before acquiring any holdout outcome data

sampling.reference: official scheduled race start UTC; obtain schedule metadata only after model freeze
sampling.driver_denominator: all registered race drivers at every predeclared cutoff
sampling.partition_unit: entire event, never shuffled neighboring laps

metrics.lap: unconditional future full-lap duration MAE and coverage
metrics.gap: fresh last-available interval-report MAE at a fixed horizon, not synchronized physical gap
metrics.paired_comparison: same targets for each method; report per-race metrics and equal-race aggregate
metrics.strategy: no causal benefit claim; unknown action-matched evidence remains unscored

tuning_policy: Bahrain-only development may inform defaults; holdout errors must not inform this frozen version. Any subsequent tuning requires a newly reserved whole-event test set.
fallback_policy: If a selected race lacks a required source, report unavailable coverage without substituting a race after viewing outcomes
